### what_to_do_first.details[1]
Sentence: Because Finland lacks a national system monitoring access to care, the team recommends reporting referral-to-treatment access times using THL guidance Ohjaus 21/2016 definitions for 16 cancers and flagging stalled handovers while STM roadmap measure 3.1.2 plans national cancer-specific pathway descriptions and access times by 2026–2028 and for all significant cancers by 2029–2031.
